testcase.name: an INCLUDE line the session adds to the main file is an edit the writer can undo
the screens find the kit's state of each document
an editor asked for after the session ended is not watched
a file with mixed line breaks, open and untouched, is reloaded silently when it changes outside
what is typed into the kit's editor is unsaved, journaled, and back in a kit editor after the process died
a file with CRLF line breaks is saved with CRLF line breaks after typing
typing that the editor has not reported yet is never replaced by a reload
a reload from storage reaches the kit's editor as a load, not as an edit
loading storage's version written with other line breaks leaves the file saved, and writes nothing
load theirs is an edit the writer can undo, and Undo brings their own text back as unsaved changes
an untouched CRLF file is not unsaved and is never written
after the process died each file opens at its cursor and with the same line at the top
